summary: Abbotts Group is a West Perth chartered accounting, wealth, finance broking and personal insurance group founded in 1990 with up to 40 professional staff. Its accounting arm has absorbed two practices (2023 and 2024), runs its own bookkeeping team and has advertised for a client services administrator in 2026. Both contacts on file (Bez Esquivel, Scott Reid) sit in the finance broking and insurance arms, not the accounting arm that would use Vert.

hooks.text: Two accounting practices absorbed in 2023 and 2024 means acquired clients' books to bring onto one process; the bookkeeping team sits in the accounting arm.
Bez has an IT-services background alongside finance, so he may be open to a tech conversation and can route to the accounting directors.
Feb 2026 'We're Growing!' hiring post and cloud accounting/Payday Super positioning show a firm investing in systems and capacity.

risks.text: Neither contact is in the accounting arm: Bez is a finance broker and Scott Reid is an insurance adviser. The accounting leaders (Executive Chairman/CEO Christopher Higham; Group Directors Eric Ballard, Kyle Flugge, Patrick Thatcher) are not on file, so the email must ask for the right person.
Perth-based, outside the Melbourne focus; multi-service group where accounting is one arm among wealth, broking, insurance and legal.
Headcount sources conflict (LinkedIn 16, site 26+, careers page up to 40).

gaps: No podcast, video or Facebook content found.
The Senior Bookkeeper ad is on a third-party board with no posting date.
No evidence of a specific reconciliation or automation tool in use.
No individual LinkedIn profiles for the accounting directors were read.

first.subject: Bookkeeping across Abbotts' acquired practices
first.body:
Hi Bez,

Abbotts has taken on two accounting practices, one in 2023 and the other in 2024 and it runs its own bookkeeping team for clients. That is a lot of acquired client books to bring onto one process. With your IT background as well as finance, I thought you would want to hear about Vert, which turns hours of manual reconciliation into minutes with an audit trail on every match. Are you the right person for this, or is there someone on the accounting side I should ask?

Best,
Dawoud
Vert | https://vertfinance.tech

followUp.subject: Re: Bookkeeping across Abbotts' acquired practices
followUp.body:
Hi Bez,

Following up on my note last week. I saw Abbotts posted a "We're Growing!" ad in February, and your bookkeepers work in both Xero and MYOB. Switching acquired clients between systems usually leaves reconciliation as the slow step. Could you point me to whoever runs your bookkeeping team? A ten minute walkthrough of Vert is all I'm after.

Best,
Dawoud
Vert | https://vertfinance.tech
